name: edify-planning-tool
description: CSS build pipeline: compiles Tailwind sources, then generates class-indexed shared styles in static/build/css. Generated assets are committed; edit source styles only.

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -i assets/css/tailwind.source.css --minify -o static/css/main.css && tailwindcss -i assets/css/tokens.source.css --minify -o static/css/tokens.css && node scripts/build_indexed_css.cjs
